correctness.rationale: For every n>=6, dihedral averaging is objective-nonincreasing and reduces arbitrary symmetric stochastic matrices to p0,p1,p2. Fourier characters produce a quadratic polynomial anchored at 1. The chosen middle frequency is proved nearest to the endpoint midpoint by exhaustive residue-class trigonometry. Its three alternating extrema prove the exact relaxed minimax lower bound and uniqueness within the invariant class. Explicit parity-sensitive factorizations prove p0>0 and p1,p2>0; hence the relaxed optimum is feasible globally. The n=5 complete-graph case and large-n expansions are separate. The local standalone verifier passed 1,006,259 counted assertions, including exhaustive spectra n<=1000 and separately formulated LP n<=80; these finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem.

Published record searches yielded no same claim; neither unsuccessful search nor dataset partition establishes novelty. A historically unindexed exact formula remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: Second-power cycles are the canonical uniform-spacing ring with two-hop communication links. Their exact fastest reversible mixing design was treated only asymptotically in the directly overlapping k-nearest-ring source. The finding eliminates a numerical SDP for every ring size, proves strict positivity and a unique invariant optimizer, identifies an unexpectedly nearly disconnected two-hop design with vanishing essential first-hop weights, and quantifies a fourfold asymptotic gap gain over one-hop cycles. This is a natural infinite-size classification rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
